name: pipeline-sandbox
summary: Pilot sandbox for the pipeline engine. Documentation only: Markdown files, no packages, no build, no code to run. The only file a change may touch is SANDBOX_PROBE.md.
conventions: Change only SANDBOX_PROBE.md; every other path is out of bounds.
Plain Markdown text: no HTML, no scripts, no links to run code.
Do not install, add or run any package or tool.
